What if the greatest deception in Christian history came from within? In this eye-opening exposé, we uncover how a powerful secret society—the Jesuits—crafted two conflicting theories, Futurism and Preterism, to rewrite prophetic interpretation and hide the true identity of the Antichrist revealed in Scripture. Millions of Christians still follow the jesuit ideas of the antichrist up until this day. But it's time to expose the truth from history and Scripture.
